original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Input Current Probe Handle as the approved no-probe state or a unique Type 29 Electrical Current Probe belonging to that supply, with stable reporting across reboot.
original_method: Length-check Type 39, preserve the raw handle, resolve active references through all Type 29 records, verify supply/probe ownership and read-only status/current, and repeat after approved reboot without applying load.
manual_activity: A user supplies current-probe topology/no-probe semantics and approves reboot; no electrical load or threshold adjustment is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Type 29 current-probe association for each supply
Applicable no-probe encoding and Type 39 length rule
Complete Type 29/39 raw parser and stable PSU/probe identity map
Read-only current telemetry and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not apply a load or change sensor thresholds/calibration/power state.
Require each non-sentinel handle to resolve uniquely to the required Type 29 structure.
Verify the probe monitors the same supply, not merely that the handle exists.
Stop on sensor/power/management failure; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate length/raw handle, apply the approved no-probe branch, resolve active Type 29 references, check ownership/status and diff the complete graph across reboot.
Report dangling, duplicate, wrong-owner or drifting references without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve supply-to-current-probe mapping, no-probe/version rule and reboot plan.
Resolve intentionally absent or shared measurement designs and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove structure applicability, target type, uniqueness, ownership or no-probe semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw Type 29/39; emit PSU identity/raw handle, absent decision, resolved Type 29 identity/read-only status and pre/post graph diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The current-probe scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no active load is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a length-aware Type 29/39 graph, apply the version-specific absent rule, require unique correct-type resolution and verify supply ownership/read-only sensor state across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 39 and applicable Type 29 records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and sensor-interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Input Current Probe Handle and Type 29 Electrical Current Probe definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds type-safe referential integrity, sentinel semantics and supply ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling, wrong-type, cross-supply and invalid no-probe references without risky electrical stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved current-probe topology and no-probe rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid reference does not prove probe calibration or full-load accuracy; those require separate authorized tests.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve absent/shared current probes only with documented topology and applicable semantics; an override cannot validate a dangling/wrong-type handle or add an unapproved load test.
expected_evidence: Approved supply-to-Type29 map and no-probe/version policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 29/39 records, handles and lengths
Per-supply sentinel or unique type-safe resolution with ownership/read-only status
Statement that no load, threshold or calibration changed
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot graph diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The field is a defined Type 39 cross-reference; topology/no-probe semantics are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length, sentinel and type-safe graph checks are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds Type 29 resolution, no-probe, ownership and no-load safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its handle/sensor coverage while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates topology/version/reboot readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a numeric handle or incidental sensor reading from passing unless it forms the intended type-safe PSU-to-current-probe relationship.
independent_technical_reasoning: This field asserts referential ownership, not measurement accuracy; it is validated by structure applicability, sentinel/type/identity relationships and stable read-only state.
